india_context.procedural_notes: Under Industrial Disputes Act 1947, retrenchment of a workman requires 1 month notice in writing, 15 days average pay per completed year of service, and notice to government authorities.
india_context.transitional_notes: Upcoming Labour Codes (Industrial Relations Code 2020) will alter retrenchment employee threshold from 100 to 300 workmen once notified.
verification_requirements: Confirm payment of statutory gratuity under Payment of Gratuity Act 1972 (mandatory after 5 continuous years).
